objective: Validate V3 from a clean detached Git checkout that preserves VCS metadata required by build backends, while exercising the frozen legacy metadata extension.

frozen_observations.xdist_failure: setuptools-scm rejected git-archive materialization because /data/project had no .git metadata.
frozen_observations.legacy_failure: gpkit and Reticulum matched egg-link provenance but required PKG-INFO snapshot support.

runner_contract.source: Create a local, no-hardlinks, no-checkout clone from the retained Git object database; checkout the exact revision detached. Never copy retained worktree files and never fetch.
runner_contract.cleanliness_gate: Before bootstrap, HEAD must equal the target revision, the tree hash must match the retained object database, and `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` must be empty.
runner_contract.container_git_gate: Because a macOS bind mount may have a different owner inside Linux, add only /data/project to Git safe.directory before bootstrap; do not modify repository content.
runner_contract.mount: Mount the temporary clean checkout at /data/project and EnvSolve policy code read-only.
runner_contract.bootstrap: Source the exact inherited frozen script in one persistent shell after reproducing the verifier-owned build_output precondition.
runner_contract.network_transition: Allow network only during bootstrap; disconnect every Docker network before metadata collection and probes.
runner_contract.project_distribution: Use frozen PEP 610 or legacy egg-link plus project-owned metadata provenance.
runner_contract.probe_execution: Use the unchanged Round 3 smoke policy from an empty directory with a 30-second timeout.
runner_contract.cleanup: Always remove the container and temporary clone.

expected_causal_checks.pytest-dev/pytest-xdist: Must pass the previous setuptools-scm version-inference stage; any later failure is reported separately.
expected_causal_checks.convexengineering/gpkit: A known V3 result requires legacy-egg-link provenance, metadata_source=PKG-INFO, and content-addressed package probes.
expected_causal_checks.markqvist/reticulum: A known V3 result requires legacy-egg-link provenance, metadata_source=PKG-INFO, and content-addressed package or entry-point probes.
expected_causal_checks.jaraco/inflect: PEP 610 package-import behavior is a non-regression control.
expected_causal_checks.python-poetry/poetry: PEP 610 entry-point and CLI behavior is a non-regression control.
expected_causal_checks.official_outcomes: No official verifier runs and no official score changes.
